name: session-village
description: A pixel-art RPG village behind the conversation that lives at the pace of the session: model, effort, context, limits, cost, tools, tasks and PR waves.

margin_left.title: Left margin (px)
margin_left.description: Room left free on the left of the village, such as the width of the sidebar. 0: no margin.

margin_right.title: Right margin (px)
margin_right.description: Room left free on the right of the village, such as the width of an open panel. 0: no margin.

frame_interval.title: Time between two frames (s)
frame_interval.description: The world moves on and a backdrop frame may go out once per interval. Less for smoother motion, more for a machine that struggles. Between 0.1 and 10.
